note: Container findings that are accepted, so the Trivy gate fails only on NEW ones. This is an exception list, not a suppression list: every entry names the deployment-specific reason the finding is not reachable AND the change that deletes the entry. Nothing goes in here because it is inconvenient. An entry that stops matching is reported by the gate so it gets removed.

history.removedBecause: Its own removeWhen condition was met, by the second of the two options it named: the bootstrap image stopped shipping npm at all. `npm run create-indexes -w packages/server` was only ever an indirection for `tsx scripts/create-indexes.ts`, so the stage now invokes that binary directly and deletes the global npm, exactly as the `app` stage already did. That removed this finding and three more in the same vendored tree — CVE-2026-69152 (brace-expansion again), CVE-2026-69192 (ip-address, SSRF and trust-boundary bypass) and the undici advisory the npm upgrade existed to dodge — none of which npm ships a release for, because they live under /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/node_modules where this project's root `overrides` provably cannot reach. Kept here rather than deleted so the next person to reach for an exception can see one being paid off instead of renewed.
